commands.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -B -c 'import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
p = json.loads(Path(\"project/recovery-inventory.json\").read_text())
sample = p[\"retained_sample\"]
b = bytes.fromhex(sample[\"value_hex\"])
pos = 5

def avro_long():
    global pos
    n = shift = 0
    while True:
        x = b[pos]
        pos += 1
        n |= (x & 127) << shift
        if not (x & 128):
            return (n >> 1) "'^ -(n & 1)
        shift += 7

def avro_string():
    global pos
    size = avro_long()
    if size < 0:
        raise ValueError("negative string length")
    value = b[pos:pos+size].decode("utf-8")
    pos += size
    return value

account, currency, amount = avro_string(), avro_string(), avro_long()
writer_id = int.from_bytes(b[1:5], "big")
expected = sample["source_ledger"]
assert b[0] == 0 and writer_id == 42 and pos == len(b)
assert (account, currency, amount) == (expected["account"], expected["currency"], expected["amount_minor"])
assert Decimal(amount) / 100 == Decimal(expected["amount_decimal"])
source = p["source"]
target = p["target"]
required = {s["id"]: s for s in source["schemas"]}
current = {s["id"]: s for s in target["schemas"]}
source_versions = {(s["subject"],s["version"]): s for s in source["schemas"]}
target_versions = {(s["subject"],s["version"]): s for s in target["schemas"]}
closure = []
for s in source["schemas"]:
    for ref in s["references"]:
        key = (ref["subject"], ref["version"])
        resolved = source_versions[key]
        closure.append({"reference": ref, "source_id": resolved["id"], "present_in_target": key in target_versions})
print(json.dumps({
  "check_kind": "offline supplied-inventory and sample-byte checks only; no registry or SDK execution",
  "sample": {"magic_byte":b[0], "writer_id":writer_id, "account":account, "currency":currency, "amount_minor":amount, "decimal_usd_if_cents":str(Decimal(amount)/100), "decimal_usd_if_micro_usd":str(Decimal(amount)/1000000), "all_payload_bytes_consumed":pos == len(b)},
  "known_required_ids":sorted(required),
  "target_id_42_fullname":current[42]["schema"]["namespace"]+"."+current[42]["schema"]["name"],
  "source_reference_closure":closure,
  "source_subject_configs":source["compatibility"],
  "supplied_topic_count_and_checksum":p["business_topic_check"]
}, indent=2))
'"'"
